description: Distill a reusable voice from raw text — no Collection or browser extension needed. Feed it pasted posts, a chat/dialogue transcript, WhatsApp-export text, or your own well-crafted writing sample, and it reverse-engineers a voiceProfile (tone, diction, cadence, emoji/formatting habits, themes, dos/donts) + exemplars. Provide `text` (auto-split into samples) and/or `samples` (already-split). Runs an LLM call (a few seconds).

authorLabel.description: Who the voice belongs to, for a more grounded analysis.

name.description: Persona name. Defaults to '<author> voice' or 'Custom voice'.

platform.description: Optional metadata tag for the samples (e.g. 'whatsapp', 'x').

samples.description: Pre-split writing samples (alternative or addition to `text`).

speaker.description: If `text` is a chat transcript, keep only this speaker's lines (name match) — so a group chat yields one person's voice.

text.description: A raw blob to distill: posts, a dialogue, a chat transcript, or a writing sample. Auto-split into samples.

name: neuron_build_persona_from_text
title: Build Persona from Text
